Subject: Price-Range Validation + PO Thresholds for Acme AI Pilot (recap & next steps)

Hi Caroline / Rajesh —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can finalize the pilot paperwork and procurement path. Notes below are pulled from the call and the cost model I mentioned (attached).

Summary of expected usage (your estimate):
- Active users (chat + LLM features): ~12k MAU
- Average tokens per session: ~1.2k tokens
- Estimated sessions per MAU per month: ~15
=> Estimated monthly tokens: ~12k * 1.2k * 15 = ~216M tokens/month (rounded)

Target unit economics (proposal):
- Reference list pricing (on-demand): $1,200 per 1M tokens
- Committed pilot (3 months / reserve): $950 per 1M tokens
- Deeper commit (12mo reserved): $760 per 1M tokens (requires PO/commit)

Monthly spend band (based on 216M tokens):
- At $1,200/1M => ~$259,200/month
- At $950/1M => ~$205,200/month
- At $760/1M (12mo reserved) => ~$164,160/month

Procurement thresholds and common Redwood playbook (we asked procurement during pilot ops):
- < $50k: can often be purchased on a corporate card (fast)
- $50k - $150k: requires a PO and 2-3 week procurement/finance approval
- $150k - $500k: requires standard SOW + PO; 3-6 week lead time (legal review likely)
- > $500k: requires procurement committee review, possible security/architecture SOW; 6+ weeks

Immediate asks / next steps (can you confirm the following?):
1) Please confirm whether Acme’s PO threshold that triggers finance/PO approval is $150k or $50k (I heard differing numbers on the call).
2) Can you confirm whether the pilot will be invoiced monthly or as a single quarterly invoice?
3) Who is the procurement contact we should loop in (name + email) so we can send a one-page procurement summary and estimated invoice schedule?

Attachments: Redwood_Acme_Pilot_OnePager.pdf (proposal summary), acme_cost-model_v1.xlsx (token math + three pricing scenarios), SOC2-redwood-summary.pdf (requested security artifact)

If you prefer, I can convert the three scenarios above into a two-row table (monthly $ / 3mo committed spend) and circulate for procurement.

Best,
Mina Haddad

Hi Caroline — looping in a quick procurement playbook so you know what to expect from our side and to speed approvals: 

1) For pilots in the $150k - $500k window we typically issue a Master Services Agreement (MSA) + Pilot Addendum and then accept a PO. Legal usually clears the MSA in parallel with procurement (2-3 weeks).
2) We can do monthly invoices for pilot consumption with net-30 payment terms. If Acme prefers quarterly invoicing for a single PO, we can bill quarterly at the invoiced rate.
3) Committed pricing: to move from pilot ($950/1M) to 12mo reserved ($760/1M) we ask for a signed commitment and a PO that covers the agreed monthly committed quantity. Unused committed tokens do not auto-roll forward; we typically reconcile on a quarterly basis and can credit overages vs. underuse per the SOW.

Action I propose from Redwood to expedite:
- Mina: send updated 6-month projection (monthly cadence) at $950/1M and a parallel quarterly invoice view.
- Caroline / Samuel: confirm which procurement cadence (monthly PO vs quarterly PO) you want for the pilot so we can template the PO language.
- Olga: attach short MSA + pilot addendum (we keep it short) and SOC2 summary to procurement packet.

Ben Carter
